newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines orders arrest of police killers.
newsitem.headline: Philippines orders arrest of police killers.

text.p: Philippine president Fidel Ramos ordered on Friday the immediate arrest of armed men who ambushed a police jeep in northern Philippines, killing five policemen and two civilians.
"Undertake joint action without delay to apprehend and bring to justice the perpetrators of this dastardly crime," Ramos said in a handwritten directive to the area and regional police commanders.

Five policemen, including a local police chief, were killed on Wednesday afternoon when they were fired at by unidentified men along a dirt road in Iba town in Zambales province, 140 km (87 miles) north of Manila.
The policemen were on their way to investigate a crime.
Police investigators said they believed the ambush was the work of local communist rebels. But no one so far has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Ramos also ordered the police to investigate the incident and submit the findings to the Commission on Human Rights because of the involvement of two civilians and in view of a possible violation of the ceasefire agreement forged by the government and communist rebels.
The government is holding peace negotiations with the leaders of the local communist party in Utrecht in the Netherlands to end a 28-year insurgency. The peace talks will resume next month.
